run_eval_model: run eval_model to train linear and attention pooling classifiers on a frozen backbone and evaluate on test datasets
run_main_cli: run the main entry point with an OmegaConf config file or CLI args to evaluate a model on classification datasets
create_LinearClassifier: create a LinearClassifier module that applies a single linear layer to a fixed-dimension feature vector for classification
create_AttnPoolClassifier: create an AttnPoolClassifier module that uses a learnable query token with scaled dot product attention over feature tokens
create_BackboneWrapper: create a BackboneWrapper to extract multiple feature representations like cls tokens, patch tokens, and object tokens from a backbone model
